column2: Anyway, let's get Ryo out of here.
{!R}Doctor! A Mechasaurus is attacking the lab!
What!?\n\nBlast it, just when we'd finally rescued Ryo!
{!R}Is Ryo okay!?
He's safe... Though he's lost his memory...!
{!R}What...!
Hayato, come to Science City in the Jaguar! Put Musashi in the Eagle!
{!R}But then there'll be nobody left to guard the lab!
Never mind that! Hurry!
Back to the Bear, {p}!
Wahaha! I knew you was alive! I'm so happy! I figured you was a goner for sure!
Doctor, we need to hurry back to the lab...
I know!\n\nMusashi! Put Ryo in the Eagle!
But Doctor! Ryo-san has amnesia...
Ryo is the only one who can pilot the Eagle! It's rough treatment, but with luck his memory will come back!
No way! That's dangerous, Dr. Saotome!
Save your breath. When it comes to fighting, there's nobody more ruthless than the doctor.
That's why we can count on him!
Good! Getter Machines, launch!
I have a favor to ask, {p}! By now the lab has most likely been occupied by the Reptilians. If things go badly, the Getter Rays could run wild and cause a huge explosion!
What!?
So I want you to take the lab back! Getter will handle the Mechasaurus. Use that opening!
Understood, Dr. Saotome!
Ryo! Remember anything, now you're in the Eagle?
Ugh...
Telling Ryo to remember right now is only gonna torture him, Musashi!
But still...
There's something important I gotta remember, in a corner of my head... When I ride this machine, my body tingles all over... but it just won't come out!
The Mechasaurus is here!
What's that monster!?
That's our enemy, the Dinosaur Empire's Mechasaurus!
Our... enemy?
Here it comes!
.........Bring it on!
Ryo!?
Now that's more like it!
I remember...!\n\nI'm Ryoma Nagare... and this machine is Getter Robo!
Your memory's back, Ryo!?
It's back, all right, clear as day!
Dr. Saotome's idea hit the bull's-eye.
Where's the doctor now?
Headed for the lab.\n\nTo take it back from the Reptilians!
What!? All right, let's hurry!
Gore-sama, Dr. Saotome and the others have arrived at the lab!
Oho, so they've come at last.\n\nI won't forgive anyone who interferes with our plans! Whoever it is, I'll simply bury them!
The lab's almost in sight!
If we don't hurry, the doctor and {p} are gonna get whacked!
{p}? Who's that?
Explanations later! The Mechasaurus is coming!
Who those things are and what I gotta do, I'll remember in the middle of the fight!
Have you come to die, Dr. Saotome?
So you're Gore!?
Indeed. Gore, Demon King of the Underworld, ruler of all living things! Throw down your weapons and obey me.
Don't be absurd, Gore!
Your age of human prosperity is over. The Earth is entering a new age... the age of the Reptilians!
Not bad... But...! How could you, barely more than hairy apes, ever defeat me! We'll settle this another time!
Don't let him escape! After Gore!
This is Gore! Machineland, surface! .........\n\nWhat's wrong? Answer me!

{!R}We're very sorry, Emperor...\n\n{!R}We'll soon be fleeing into the magma layer. {!R}We had no time to wait for you, Emperor!! {!R}Getter's counterattack has dealt the Empire a grievous wound. {!R}Fighting on like this would mean the death of the Empire. {!R}We cannot sacrifice all the Reptilians for the Emperor's sake!
What!?
{!R}We'll go underground once more and build up our strength. {!R}Dreaming of the day the Reptilians conquer the surface again!
You'd abandon me!?
{!R}Glory to the great Emperor Gore!
Wait...!\n\nPlease, wait...!
Left behind... How pitiful, Gore.
Silence!\n\nNow all that's left is to die a death befitting an emperor!
The Reptilians will surely, one day... return to the surface...!
Gore...
{!R}Doctor! We've wiped out the Mechasaurus around the lab!
Well done... Getter Robo, return to base...!
Lower life forms, after all...\n\nPerhaps this outcome was only natural...
Let's leave the outside to Getter. Taking back the lab comes first.
The Getter Machines are out on a sortie right now. You can't go inside at the moment.
Well done, everyone!\n\nWith this, the world is saved from the threat of the Dinosaur Empire! And {p}-kun! Thank you! It's all thanks to you.
Oh, n-no...
Looks like I owe you one. Let me thank you.
If you're ever in a jam, just say so.
The Getter Team's always on your side!
Yeah! Thanks, everyone!
Now then, everyone, get to work on Getter's maintenance.
Whaaat!?
Right now, Doctor?
I'm starvin'... Lemme rest...
There's no telling when another great crisis might come to Earth.
No helping it... Let's go, you two...
Easy for you to say! You lost your memory! Me, I'm plumb tuckered out...
A great crisis... Doctor?
You understand what I'm getting at, don't you, {p}?
Yes...
{p}! Word came in from Science City. {s} is on the road to recovery!
Really!?
Just what you'd expect from Science City, the finest in the world! But the Dinosaur Empire had infiltrated even Science City.
Is that... the Dimension Chain's doing too?
I don't know... What concerns me is what Dr. Kuruma is up to...
The man who caused that uproar in the Science City conference hall?
There's no end of nasty rumors about Dr. Kuruma. And there's a rumor he's chasing the Precog Clan of Herai Village.
The Precog Clan of Herai Village?
Herai Village, a small village in the Tohoku region, is said to be a village of prophets... in other words, a village of psychics.
Why would Dr. Kuruma be after Herai Village...?
